svg.aria-label: Pánev na velkém plameni s plátky cibule, které mají černé okraje; z pánve stoupá tmavý kouř

path.style: stroke: var(--banner-fg, #1b2a4a); stroke-width: 4; stroke-dasharray: 2 12; stroke-linecap: round; opacity: .45
fill: var(--banner-warm, #e9b44c); stroke: var(--banner-fg, #1b2a4a); stroke-width: 5; stroke-linejoin: round
fill: var(--banner-accent, #c8462a); stroke: var(--banner-fg, #1b2a4a); stroke-width: 6; stroke-linejoin: round

ellipse.style: fill: var(--banner-warm, #e9b44c); fill: color-mix(in srgb, var(--banner-warm, #e9b44c) 52%, black); stroke: var(--banner-fg, #1b2a4a); stroke-width: 4

g.style: fill: none; stroke: var(--banner-fg, #1b2a4a); stroke: color-mix(in srgb, var(--banner-fg, #1b2a4a) 35%, black); stroke-width: 16; stroke-linecap: round
fill: none; stroke: var(--banner-warm, #e9b44c); stroke-width: 9; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-dasharray: 0 22 56 22
fill: none; stroke: var(--banner-fg, #1b2a4a); stroke: color-mix(in srgb, var(--banner-fg, #1b2a4a) 50%, black); stroke-width: 10; stroke-linecap: round; opacity: .6

path.style: fill: none; stroke: var(--banner-fg, #1b2a4a); stroke-width: 3; stroke-linecap: round
fill: none; stroke: var(--banner-fg, #1b2a4a); stroke-width: 3; stroke-linecap: round
